title: Mark as Read
description: The in-app notification center's read/unread state needs to actually persist, not just update in memory for the current session. Mark a notification read and confirm it stays read.
successCondition: After POST /api/notifications/:id/read, a subsequent GET /api/notifications shows that notification with read: true, and the response's unreadCount has decreased by exactly one.
hints: Trigger a notification first (e.g. book a shipment) and wait for it to appear in GET /api/notifications before marking it read.
unreadCount is computed server-side from the read flags, not just a client-side counter — don't just check the individual notification's read field.
